name: Admin Diagnostic Email Composer
description: Admin sends one follow-up branded email from the Correos tab of a diagnostic to multiple Para recipients and optional visible CC recipients. The shared hybrid picker starts with the diagnostic client, searches registered clients or accepts manual addresses, and enforces 10 unique destinations. The composer also includes subject, draggable Markdown sections, footer, attachments and real-template preview. The NDA branch generates the confidentiality PDF. History groups the delivery while retaining each address status.
